description: Record a fact in the working object, under one named field. Offered, never required: call it at the moment something becomes worth a later turn's while.

content.description: the fact, in one line, as a later turn should read it

field.description: which kind of fact it is

supersedes.description: id of an earlier entry this one replaces; omit for a new fact

description: Say what became of an entry: settled, partly settled, the wrong entry, or replaced by something said since.

entry.description: id of the entry, as the working record shows it

verdict.description: done settles it; partial settles part of it; not_this: the wrong entry; superseded: replaced by something said since

description: Propose advancing the session to the next phase, and say why. Advisory: it records a request for a ruling and writes no fact.

reason.description: why the session is ready for it
